name: TextInput
description: Single-line text field for short input such as a name, email address, or password. Renders an `<input>` element.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the text input as invalid, applying error styles. Sets `aria-invalid` on the `<input>` element.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the text input, controlling height, padding, and typography.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial text in the field. Use when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the text changes as the user types, pastes, or deletes. Receives the new text and the change event details.

props.name: value
props.description: Current text in the field. Use when controlled.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class applied to the element, or a function that returns a class based on the component’s state.

props.name: type
props.description: Kind of text the field accepts, such as an email address, password, or URL.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the element, or a function that returns a style object based on the component’s state.

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: TextInput.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
